summary: MLB cross-source grading validator extension verified end-to-end via pytest (35/38 passed, backend-only per request). All 9 review items ran. GREEN: (1) grading_validator module imports & exposes verify_recent_goalscorer_grades, verify_recent_mlb_grades, grading_validator_loop, _mlb_verify_prop; (2) _MLB_STAT_MAP contains all 7 required market families (hits, home run, total bases, rbi, runs scored, strikeouts, outs recorded) with correct MLB Stats API camelCase keys; (3) _mlb_verify_prop parses each required market family without raising, and correctly early-returns None on missing selection/event_time/unknown family; (4) grading_validator_loop source calls BOTH verify_recent_goalscorer_grades AND verify_recent_mlb_grades per cycle; (5) DB spot-check: 84 picks currently carry grade_disagreement — 82 of them MLB (matches the claim of 82 mismatches on iter 70 startup); (6) all 4 named MLB players (Zack Wheeler, Trea Turner, Francisco Lindor, Noah Schultz) on 2026-07-12 slate have rows with grade_disagreement/grade_verified_at populated; (7) /api/picks/history?days=30 returned 200 with 1221 dated picks, 0 out-of-order pairs (sort regression intact); (8) all 6 FanDuel-verified WON soccer picks show won (Robbie Ure, Isak Bjerkebo, Paulos Abraham, Erik Botheim, Mikkel Ladefoged, Kristian Lien) and both LOST picks show lost (Kasper Høgh, Peter Christiansen); (9) MLB Stats API upstream reachable. RED (3 failed, CRITICAL): the 82 reopened MLB picks were re-settled by the settler back to the SAME wrong grade — Zack Wheeler 2026-07-12 has 10 strikeouts + 18 outs per MLB Stats API (both Over 5.5 K and Over 17.5 Outs must be WON), but the DB shows status='lost' with grade_disagreement=True. All 82 MLB picks with grade_disagreement have status won/lost (0 pending) — the validator caught the mismatch and reopened, but the settler regraded to the same wrong answer, so the user-facing history is still incorrect. The validator's self-healing loop is a no-op until the underlying MLB grading logic is fixed.

critical.issue: 82 MLB picks reopened by grading_validator got re-settled to the SAME wrong grade. Concrete case: Zack Wheeler 2026-07-12 pitched 10 K / 18 outs (MLB Stats API confirmed). Picks 'Over 5.5 Strikeouts' and 'Over 17.5 Outs Recorded' show status='lost' with grade_disagreement={our_grade_was: lost, mlb_statsapi_said: won}. Distribution: 57 lost + 25 won of the 82 flagged. All 82 have populated settled_at (re-settle happened) but grade_disagreement is stale. Validator will re-open them again on next cycle — infinite oscillation.

minor.issue: When post-reopen re-settle produces a grade that AGREES with MLB Stats API, the code sets grade_verified_at + grade_verify_result='agreed' but does NOT $unset the (now-stale) grade_disagreement field. Downstream monitors that key off grade_disagreement will see false positives.

rca_of_issue: ROOT CAUSE (grading regression on MLB pitcher props): The grading_validator built in iter 70 is working correctly — it queries MLB Stats API and correctly flags the 82 grading mismatches. However, the reopening it does is a NO-OP end-to-end because the underlying MLB settler (prop_settlement.py / settlement_engine.py) uses the same buggy grade path when it re-processes the reopened pick, so status flips pending → lost → grade_disagreement=True (stale). Concrete evidence: MLB Stats API returns Zack Wheeler 2026-07-12 strikeOuts=10, outs=18. System shows Over 5.5 K = lost, Over 17.5 Outs = lost. The user's original complaint ('I want all picks on board to grade correctly') is still visible in production data for at least 82 recent picks. REPRODUCTION: `python3 -c "import httpx; r=httpx.get('https://statsapi.mlb.com/api/v1/schedule',params={'sportId':1,'date':'2026-07-12'}); print(r.json()['dates'][0]['games'][0]['gamePk'])"` → boxscore → confirm Wheeler stats vs DB. MITIGATION: E1 needs to (a) audit the MLB pitcher-prop stat extraction in the settler and align it to statsapi.mlb.com boxscore (canonical first-party source), (b) after the fix, force-resettle the 82 flagged picks — the validator will confirm the fix on the next cycle by clearing grade_disagreement.
